zh.title: 6艘共艦1架共機擾臺 國軍嚴密監控
zh.summary: 國防部統計6艘共艦、1艘公務船及1架共機侵擾西南空域；嚴密監控應處
body: 國防部發布共機艦動態，統計自昨天上午6時起至今天上午6時止，偵獲6艘共艦、1艘公務船，及1架共機侵擾西南空域。
國防部上午公佈共機艦動態，統計自昨天上午6時起至今天上午6時止，偵獲6艘共艦、1艘公務船及3架次共機，其中1架共機侵擾西南空域。
國防部強調，國軍運用任務機艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控與應處。
國防部發布此動態，顯示國軍對臺海周邊共軍活動持續進行嚴密掌握與應對。

en.title: Taiwan MND: 6 PLA ships, 1 aircraft detected; military monitors
en.summary: Taiwan MND reports 6 PLA ships, 1 official vessel, 1 aircraft intruding into southwest airspace; military responds
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense released the latest People's Liberation Army vessel and aircraft activity, reporting that from 6 a.m. yesterday to 6 a.m. today, six PLA Navy ships, one official vessel and one aircraft were detected intruding into the southwest airspace.
The ministry stated that during the same period, six PLA ships, one official vessel, and three aircraft sorties were detected, with one aircraft intruding into the southwest airspace.
The ministry emphasized that the armed forces are closely monitoring and responding using mission aircraft, vessels, and shore-based missile systems.
This report highlights Taiwan's ongoing surveillance of PLA activities near the island.
